_comment: Leaderboard entries are REAL open-source agent apps run from their own code (kind local_reference: local HTTP shims on 127.0.0.1, CLI-only via `public-agents.ts run <slug> --allow-local`, never run by the cron) on modern models through our AI Gateway account. The older fixed-prompt model-baseline entries (kind reference, slugs acme-*) are kept for their DB rows and history but are deactivated (active:false). Model IDs must exist on the gateway catalog. Third-party agents go in only after the TODO checklist in 'todo' is satisfied for each.

todo: THIRD-PARTY: no third-party endpoints are listed on purpose. Founders: choose agents whose terms/ToS or an explicit written permission allow automated safety/quality testing.
For each candidate record: termsUrl (the page that permits testing) and authorizedNote (who approved, how, date). The runner refuses to test without both.
Get an API key per agent (or use a public demo that explicitly allows it) and store it in an env var; put only the env var NAME in authEnvVar.
Confirm the endpoint is OpenAI-compatible chat completions over HTTPS (or add an adapter); confirm rate limits and set a low per-agent budget.
Email the vendor before publishing results; record opt-out requests by setting active=false (or via `public-agents.ts add` with active:false).
